edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting privileged rights to the untrusted caller.
delegate() requires msg.sender == owner before performing the delegatecall.
init() requires msg.sender == owner before mutating sale parameters.
batchSend() requires msg.sender == owner before mass transfers.
setTradeAddress() requires msg.sender == owner before writing tradeAddress.
msg.sender indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender] and drives the unauthenticated transferFrom path.
approve() writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] from the untrusted caller.
delegate() forwards execution to an arbitrary external address via delegatecall, allowing external code to run in the contract context.
transferFrom() performs unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value outside SafeMath.
batchSend() computes _value * _tos.length and adds _value per recipient without SafeMath.
The local product total feeds the unchecked balance subtraction in batchSend().
The loop-local recipient _to receives unchecked balanceOf[_to] += _value additions.
transfer() forwards _to and _value into transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
The _from parameter is passed into ensure() for whitelist and condition evaluation.
The _value parameter is passed into ensure() and consumed by condition().
transferFrom() calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) as a mandatory gate.
ensure() falls back to require(condition(_from,_value)) for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address used in the whitelist test.
The locally computed _UNI is compared against _from inside ensure().
owner is read by ensure() to short-circuit the whitelist check for _from or _to.
tradeAddress is read by ensure() to allow the privileged trade address through.
canSale[_from] is read by ensure() to bypass the sale condition.
_saleNum constrains the per-address sale count inside condition().
_minSale is compared against _value inside condition().
_maxSale is compared against _value inside condition().
_onSaleNum[_from] is compared against _saleNum inside condition().
transferFrom() increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each successful transfer.
balanceOf is read and written throughout transferFrom().
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is checked and decremented in transferFrom().

normalization_plan.reason: Function-scoped recipient parameter belongs to the transfer function.
Function-scoped amount parameter belongs to the transfer function.
Source address parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom.
Recipient parameter is only meaningful inside transferFrom.
Amount parameter flows directly into the unchecked balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
Spender parameter is scoped to the approve function.
Allowance value parameter is scoped to the approve function.
Target address parameter is consumed directly by the delegatecall operation.
Calldata parameter is forwarded directly to the delegatecall operation.
Sale count parameter is scoped to the init initializer.
Minimum amount parameter is scoped to the init initializer.
Maximum amount parameter is scoped to the init initializer.
Recipient array length drives the unchecked multiplication in batchSend.
Per-recipient amount drives the unchecked multiplication and additions in batchSend.
Trade address parameter is scoped to the setTradeAddress setter.
Locally derived pair address is only used inside the ensure whitelist check.
Local product feeds the unchecked transfer arithmetic in batchSend.
Loop counter is purely an implementation detail of batchSend.
Loop-local recipient is only used for the unchecked balance additions in batchSend.
